study.title: Crop Classification from Drone Imagery Based on Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Methods
study.short_title: Improved PP-LiteSeg 9-class crop semantic seg from UAV RGB

segmentation.domain: crop-type classification (semantic segmentation) from UAV visible-light images: 9 classes incl. rice, soybean, red bean, wheat, corn, poplar, coniferous tree, road, background
models_tested: Improved PP-LiteSeg with SPPF-CSPC-A pooling module + sparse self-attention, STDCNet backbone (proposed)
segmentation.best_model: Improved PP-LiteSeg: MIoU 0.9479, Acc 0.9902, Kappa 0.9872, 12.3 FPS @ 512x512, 12.08 M params, 9 GFLOPs

dataset.name: UAV visible-light crop-classification dataset (Suibin County, Heilongjiang, China; ~8 km apart large-scale farmland + rice science-technology park)
dataset.note: DJI M300 RTK + Zenmuse P1 (35 mm, 8192x5460, 45 MP); collected July-Sept 2022/2023; 70% lateral / 80% longitudinal overlap, 17 m/s. Altitudes/GSD: 30 m -> 0.375 cm/px (rice, tilt 45 deg), 40 m -> 0.5 cm/px (wheat/maize), 160 m -> 2 cm/px, 450 m -> 5.625 cm/px (blur/robustness test). LabelMe pixel annotation, split to 512x512 patches -> 23,681 images; 8:2 train/val (train = 2023 rice park + 11 Jul 2023 farmland; test = remaining incl. 2022 sets). Heavy imbalance (rice 62.64% of pixels; wheat 0.83%); OhemCrossEntropyLoss; RandomDistort/PaddingCrop/HorizontalFlip augmentation.

segmentation.backbone: STDCNet (5 stages, stride 2, 1/32 output) + SPPF-CSPC-A (adaptive average pooling + CSPC + SPPF) + sparse self-attention + UAFM/SPPM-based PP-LiteSeg decoder

mIoU.quote: Table 8: Training results of different models on the dataset of this paper ... Ours ... MIoU 94.79%
mIoU.ambiguity: MIoU of improved model (2.79% over PP-LiteSeg baseline 92.00%). Class IoUs (Table 9): background 0.9020, road 0.9128, rice 0.9949, red bean 0.9793, coniferous 0.8349, wheat 0.9974, soybean 0.9889, poplar 0.9243, corn 0.9968.

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; class precision/recall given in Table 9 (e.g. rice 0.9985/0.9964, corn 0.9979/0.9989) from which F1 could be derived.

PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy (Eq. 6) = pixel accuracy; also Kappa 0.9872. Class precision/recall in Table 9.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not directly reported; per-class precision/recall and IoU available (Table 9) for crop classes.

edge.framework: PaddlePaddle (SGD, lr 0.01 PolynomialDecay, 150 epochs, OhemCrossEntropyLoss); Intel i9-12700 @ 3.20 GHz, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 32 GB

fps.quote: In terms of prediction speed, our model is able to predict 512 x 512-pixel UAV visible light images at 12.3 FPS, which is in the middle of the range and meets the real-time requirement.
fps.ambiguity: FPS measured on DESKTOP NVIDIA RTX 3090 over 6400 images of 512x512 (not an edge device). Baseline PP-LiteSeg 13.3 FPS; other models 4.6-16.7 FPS. Authors claim real-time suitability for edge/mobile deployment (Section 4.3) but perform no on-device benchmark.

latency_ms.ambiguity: Not directly reported; ~81.3 ms/image implied by 12.3 FPS (derived).

params_M.quote: Table 14: Training results of high precision models ... Ours ... Params 12.08 M
params_M.ambiguity: Model size (12.08 M) vs 13.41-86.96 M for U-Net/FCN/PSPNet/SegNet etc.; part of lightweight claim for edge/mobile deployment.

gflops.ambiguity: Inference FLOPs 9 GFLOPs (9 G in Table 8/14), vs e.g. SegNeXt 49.5 G, DeepLabV3+ 191.97 G; supports low-cost/edge deployment claim.

issues: Real-time FPS measured on a desktop NVIDIA RTX 3090, not an edge device; edge/mobile deployment discussed qualitatively (Section 4.3) without on-device benchmarks.
Resolution/altitude heterogeneous across training/test subsets (GSD 0.00375-0.05625 m/px); resolution_gsp_m left null with ranges in dataset note.
9-class crop classification (weeds not a class); weed/crop F1 not applicable.
F1 not reported (per-class precision/recall in Table 9); no Dice.
Training on 2023 images, testing on 2022 (incl. 450 m blurred) images - a deliberate robustness test; dataset not public.
